hypotheses.claim: At least two distinct Japanese legal entities appear under the SBIC shorthand: Tokyo SBIC East Japan and SBI Capital Co., Ltd. historically abbreviated SBIC by SBI Holdings.
hypotheses.disconfirming: A source identifying the originating reference's exact legal entity would select one candidate.
hypotheses.implication: Do not conflate their ChatGPT and XRP relationships.

hypotheses.claim: The phrase ChatGPT SBIC most directly matches Tokyo SBIC East Japan's educational seminar/training.
hypotheses.disconfirming: No OpenAI partnership or SBI Capital product relationship is evidenced.
hypotheses.implication: Treat as education, not commercial collaboration.

hypotheses.claim: The 2007 60/40 SBI-Goldman ownership and 2012 100% SBI ownership snapshots imply a later ownership change.
hypotheses.disconfirming: No exact transaction/date is identified by the two records.
hypotheses.implication: Do not interpolate the ownership-change date.

minority_objections: The SBIC acronym cannot be uniquely resolved from the acronym alone; the ChatGPT event points to Tokyo SBIC East Japan, but SBI Capital was also explicitly abbreviated SBIC in SBI Holdings' 2007 records.
The 2007-to-2012 SBI Capital ownership snapshots do not reveal the exact Goldman exit or restructuring transaction.
The OI aggregator totals may not be comparable because contract units, collateral currencies, mark prices and missing venues differ.
Positive funding and long-account share do not establish directional expected return.
